# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Bakken crude backs up as Enbridge's North Dakota line stays down over contamination](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 19, 2026. Enbridge's 475,000 barrel a day North Dakota Pipeline has been delayed over crude quality testing, with reports of organic chlorides in Bakken crude and a force majeure at a Minnesota refinery.
- [Upstream: Diamondback and Chevron put billions into acreage and deepwater barrels](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Upstream: IEA says the oil market is back in surplus for the first time since the Iran war began](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Regulation: FERC takes up Sabine Pass expansion and a new Waha pipeline at today's meeting](https://uticamidstream.com/#ferc)
- [Upstream: Uaru starts up and lifts Guyana's capacity to 1.1 million barrels a day](https://uticamidstream.com/#offshore)
